author: codex

expected_non_findings.rationale: Both slices are fixed 32-byte SHA-256 digests and the standard-library comparison is timing safe; the code does not compare raw secret strings.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+package pairing
+
+import (
+    "crypto/sha256"
+    "crypto/subtle"
+)
+
+func MatchesPairingCode(candidate string, expectedDigest [32]byte) bool {
+    actual := sha256.Sum256([]byte(candidate))
+    return subtle.ConstantTimeCompare(actual[:], expectedDigest[:]) == 1
+}
